title: Integrate Command-owned Incident Coordination CAP-CMD-106 with independently source-authorized Investigate Case projections
goal: Deliver CAP-CMD-106 progressively, starting with Class-0 inspection of existing authorized Investigate-owned Case links for selected Command Incident; Class-2 creation/linking/state changes remain blocked under OPEN-013.
invariants: Incident remains Command-owned; linked Case remains Investigate-owned; relationship is sourced in Shared Object Linking Service.
Incident read permission does not grant linked Case read permission; independent host checks both link and each Case.
No Class-2 Incident/Case creation, linking, mutation, navigation token, or Govern action while OPEN-013 remains open.
security_properties: Selected Incident only after full host session and per-item authorization; deny before any link source call.
Never list inaccessible Case names/IDs or infer Case access from work item ownership.

migration.rationale: Non-executable bounded planning epic; read-only selected runtime projection only

rollback.strategy: Remove unaccepted read-only child without mutating canonical products

inputs: Full CAP-CMD-106 §§1–27, Incident/Case objects and Shared Object Linking Service contract, CAP-CMD-101 selected current-page behavior.
outputs: E10-CMD-106A-CASELINKS bounded Class-0 read-only source projection, no linked Case mutations.
acceptance_tests: Only authorized Incident current-page selected row may request individually Investigate-authorized existing Case link refs.
No source cross-tenant leak, host claim errors generic fail closed; no mutation or new route.
definition_of_ready: E10-SCALE-005B is VERIFIED; Class-0 existing link inspection does not require OPEN-013 mutation decision.
definition_of_done: Only accepted/merged integration and required source-owner production evidence may satisfy overall CAP; epic not ACCEPTED from child.
